title: Hearty Bitter Malaysian Fennel Curry
description: A rich and flavorful Malaysian curry featuring bitter fennel bulb, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This dish is brine-wet and raw-friendly, making it a great option for those looking for a unique twist on traditional curry.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the sliced fennel bulb and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it starts to soften.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, until the spices are fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and brine, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the fennel is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season the curry with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
